headline: Ownership Battles Intensify Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: The new returns show the war’s ownership struggle tightening around several divided or recently shifting sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ledger, with 39 ownership events in 24 hours, nine in the latest two-hour window, and its nine bases standing one Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral. Stlican Shelf has risen to 28 events, including six recently, while its holdings read two Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral. Nevish Line records 20 events, six in the latest two hours, and remains split six Warden to two Colonial. Kuura Strand has newly come alive with four events, all recent, leaving five Warden bases and one neutral. Palantine Berm reports 12 events, five within six hours, though only one in the last two. Callahan’s Passage shows no fresh ownership event in the latest two hours, but its battle ledger remains heavy, with more than 3,600 combined casualties recorded there in that span. Fisherman’s Row also saw three rapid events at Black Well. Other sectors chiefly show enlistment or casualty movement without recorded base changes. No victor is declared.
